title: Victim in fatal RCMP shooting ID'd
article: Vancouver police have released the name of the man shot to death last Friday evening by RCMP in suburban Langley.
Jeffrey James Alvin Wright, 22, was killed on Aug. 6 when Mounties arrived at an apartment in Langley, southeast of Vancouver, following a report of a domestic disturbance.
Vancouver police Const. Jana McGuinness said Wright was shot by a veteran RCMP officer. The officer's name has not been released.
McGuinness said the incident occurred when officers were confronted by a man as they searched the apartment, but further details of the shooting have not been provided.
The Langley RCMP detachment asked the Vancouver force to take over the investigation after Wright died in hospital.
McGuinness said the investigation is ongoing but additional updates are not immediately expected.
